thread:
Ada: Noticed a steady trickle of small GPU pods being evicted and rescheduled in ap-south1 for ~25m. Packing index dropped and tail latency for short jobs spiked.
Mike: Any node events?
Ada: events show repeated FailedAttachVolume + DeviceDetach errors around the time nodes briefly go NotReady: `attach failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded` and `device detach: unexpected state`.
Tomas: That matches a pattern where transient host-level attach/detach flakiness causes kubelet to taint nodes briefly, scheduler then aggressively scatters tiny pods causing fragmentation and extra GPU-hours.
Ada: Cost hit is noticeable: rough +6% compute uplift in that pool last 3h.
Mike: We have short nodeFlipGrace of 8s. When drivers are flaky that's too aggressive. Short-term fix ideas: 1) bump kubelet attachTimeout on warmpool nodes (canary) to 45s, 2) increase scheduler nodeFlipGrace to 25s for warmpool label, 3) reduce preferSpread for tiny-pod class so they co-locate during transient shortages.
Tomas: Also capture NIC/driver logs and cloud provider attach traces. If driver/kernel mismatch causing detach flaps we need a firmware/hypervisor ticket.
Infra-bot: Suggestion: apply scoped scheduler patch and kubelet canary. Example commands: `kubectl patch cm warmpool-canary-kubelet -n infra --patch '{"data":{"attachTimeout":"45s"}}'` and `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n kube-system --type merge -p '{"data":{"nodeFlipGrace":"25s","preemptScoreScale":"0.6"}}' --selector nodepool=warmpool-canary`
Mike: Let's do the kubelet canary first, then scoped scheduler softening if canary improves.
Ops-automation-bot: Patching warmpool-canary kubelet config now and will monitor evictions for 15m. Auto-revert in 2h if not promoted.
Ada: Canary metrics after 10m: evictions down ~58%, packing index improved, latency for short jobs normalized.
Tomas: Good signal. Next steps: expand to second canary, open infra ticket to collect NIC firmware/kernel/attach latency and involve cloud provider if attach RPCs are timing out. Also add scheduler CI test for 10-30s NodeNotReady flaps to avoid immediate scatter.
Mike: I'll own rollout and follow-up. Adding cost delta tracking to the incident doc.
Infra-bot: Temporary scheduler config applied to canary; will auto-revert unless promoted.
Ops-automation-bot: Alert cleared: evictions-high for cluster/ap-south1 (resolved in canary).
